# Tree-scale synthetic fixture

End-to-end P17 fixture: one synthetic 1 ha block (`B01`) with 12 synthetic trees,
one machine, one landing, and one assignment. The tree inventory is the P17.1
contract fixture rewritten to block `B01`. Work volume is set to the reference
stem model's merchantable total so the mapping/stem/replay reconciliation is
clean.

Everything is synthetic. Do not use it as a real tree map, machine dataset, or
operational plan.
